title: Initech — Account Notes
body: Initech is a mid-market account, owned by Sam Reyes. Current ARR: $185,000. Deployment: 300 licensed seats across two departments. Renewal date: 2027-01-15. Relationship is stable but under-penetrated relative to Initech's total headcount (~2,000) — flagged as an expansion opportunity for the next fiscal year's account planning.
